title: DriveArena: A Closed-Loop Generative Simulation Platform for Autonomous Driving
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view (surround-view) images generated autoregressively as a stream of arbitrary length

control_signal.value: map and vehicle layouts from a Traffic Manager (3D boxes, BEV map, projected canvases), camera parameters, relative ego pose, reference image and text prompts for weather and style

control_mechanism.value: condition encoders feeding a randomly initialised ControlNet on the UNet; reference features via cross-attention; cross-view attention; autoregressive reuse of previous frames and relative pose

base_model.value: Stable Diffusion v1.5 initialised, only new parameters trained; CLIP text and image encoders; ControlNet; UniAD used as the driving agent

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val scenes) with GPT-4V scene descriptions; zero-shot tests on nuPlan and CARLA road networks

metrics.value: Agent-side PDM Score and subscores (NC, DAC, EP, TTC, C), route completion and Arena Driving Score. FID/FVD not in the packet.

controllability_evidence.value: UniAD PDMS 0.902 on generated images versus 0.910 on original nuScenes; qualitative adherence to lanes and boxes, including nuPlan and CARLA layouts.

closed_loop.value: Yes: UniAD trajectories drive the ego vehicle through the Traffic Manager and generated images; four routes, average route completion 0.137 and ADS 0.086.

stated_limitations.value: Trained only on nuScenes (limited diversity); temporal consistency between frames is hard; high runtime; few agents tested so far.

notes: Platform paper: the controllable generator (World Dreamer) is one module plus a rule-based Traffic Manager and an agent. Controllability is mostly qualitative.
